payload.title: Cards hotlink third-party images instead of a stored copy
payload.description: Found while scanning Machines on Machines index cards (2026-11-09): some cards use an image URL on someone else's host as the front-matter image: arXiv teasers, Guardian (i.guim.co.uk), Springer, Wikimedia (upload.wikimedia.org), 21no.de, archive.aec.at. Fragility: the picture disappears or changes when the third party moves, renames, hotlink-blocks or removes it; a reader's browser contacts the third party when a card scrolls into view (privacy, no way for us to cache or resize it); no responsive renditions, no Night version. Rights question: showing a copy we do not store may still need a licence or credit, and storing a copy needs the right to copy it (third-party images are always credited, generated ones are not). To decide: which sources may be copied (licence, fair use, press kit), whether the capture step (references capture-thumbnails style) should store a copy at media/assets/... for these cards, and what a card shows when no stored copy is allowed (placeholder art). Not fixed here; the card-image rendition fix (fix/card-image-src) only covers pictures we store.
